mapper.sql: FROM purchase_order_items i INNER JOIN purchase_orders o ON o.id = i.order_id LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = o.supplier_id LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN drugs d ON d.id = i.drug_id

where.if: AND o.status IN ('已确认', '已过账')
AND (o.status IS NULL OR o.status NOT IN ('已确认', '已过账'))

mapper.select:
SELECT i.id AS itemId, o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.invoice_no AS invoiceNo, o.supplier_id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, w.name AS warehouseName, o.biz_date AS bizDate, o.status AS status, CASE WHEN o.status IN ('已确认', '已过账') THEN '已入库' ELSE '未入库' END AS inboundStatus, CONCAT(IFNULL(d.generic_name, ''), IF(d.spec IS NULL OR d.spec = '', '', CONCAT(' ', d.spec))) AS drugName, d.spec AS drugSpec, i.batch_no AS batchNo, i.receive_qty AS receiveQty, i.stock_in_qty AS stockInQty, i.purchase_price AS purchasePrice, IFNULL(i.amount, IFNULL(i.receive_qty, 0) * IFNULL(i.purchase_price, 0)) AS amount, i.quality_status AS qualityStatus
ORDER BY o.biz_date DESC, o.id DESC, i.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.invoice_no) AS invoiceCount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(i.receive_qty, 0)), 0) AS qty, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(i.amount, IFNULL(i.receive_qty, 0) * IFNULL(i.purchase_price, 0))), 0) AS amount
